content: PWA storage is 'best-effort' by default and can be evicted under storage pressure unless navigator.storage.persist() is granted; check navigator.storage.estimate() and wrap writes in try/catch for QuotaExceededError (IDB/Cache/OPFS can use up to ~60% of disk). Service-worker update trap: new SW waits unless skipWaiting, but skipWaiting mid-session can swap assets under a running page and break it; stale precache serves old app. Must request persistent storage early, handle quota, and use a controlled SW update flow with user prompt rather than blind skipWaiting.
